tools.name: lookup_barcode
tools.description: Find the product for one barcode: UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, EAN-8, GTIN-14, ISBN-10 or ISBN-13. Returns the title and, where known, brand, category, description, image, price, identifiers and book details. Uses one lookup from the monthly allowance, even when the code is not found.

tools.name: lookup_barcodes
tools.description: Find the products for up to 100 barcodes in one call. Duplicates are ignored. Uses one lookup per distinct code; if the batch would exceed the remaining allowance, nothing is looked up or charged.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products by title, brand or category when you have a name rather than a barcode. Returns barcode, title, brand, category and image for the best matches. Words shorter than 3 letters are ignored. Uses one lookup per call.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show the account's plan, monthly allowance, lookups used and when usage resets. Free.
